title: LikeCoin governance capture — CP realizable ~$2.6k (nominal $118-135k) vs solo-quorum stake 408.16M LIKE (impossible); deposit path gated by 3 bonded validators
closed_reasons: Solo-quorum capture is arithmetically impossible, not merely expensive: q/(1-q) x 612,235,423 bonded = 408,156,948.77 LIKE needed, vs total liquid float 241,454,975.96 LIKE and total AMM inventory 2,673,595.45 LIKE (153x short); no CEX/OTC market for v2 LIKE. Veto-proof stake = 1,224,470,846 LIKE > total supply.

v2->v3 token migration closed 2026-02-02 (official: 'v2 tokens will lose all value' from 2026-02-03); v2 LIKE has no conversion and only ~$2.6k of exit liquidity left in 3 Osmosis pools -> CP realizable ~$2.6k, not the $135k nominal mark.

CommunityPoolSpendProposal is capped at the fee-pool DecCoins accounting by SDK v0.46.16 DistributeFromFeePool SafeSub (likecoin/cosmos-sdk v0.46.16-dual-prefix); the distribution module's extra 26,712,763.38 LIKE is unreachable via any standard proposal (software-upgrade-only, P).
IBC escrow balances (11,163,090.31 LIKE total; Osmosis 10.91M, cosmoshub-4 255k) unlock only via counterparty IBC burns; no gov spend path (upgrade-only, P).
No other module accounts hold funds (gov, fee_collector, likenft, mint, nft, transfer all empty); no bridge contracts exist on this chain (no CosmWasm).
E-U = $0: no unprivileged direct path; the only live route is governance (capture), gated by the 3 bonded validators who hold 100% of the 612.24M bonded power.
key_facts: Gov params (genesis tally_params + props 8 & 18; live /cosmos/gov/*/params returns HTTP 501 on the public LCD, so reconstructed from genesis + all ParameterChangeProposals): quorum 0.40, threshold 0.50, veto_threshold 0.334, min_deposit 100,000 LIKE, max_deposit_period 14d, voting_period 7d, burn_vote_veto true (refund on pass/reject, burn only on veto); unbonding 21d; community tax 2%; inflation 0% (prop 90).

Live state h 27,049,046 (2026-10-08T17:50:42Z): bonded 612,235,423.15 LIKE; not-bonded 496,147,229.92; supply 1,467,694,529.01; community pool 79,981,046.28 LIKE (only nanolike); distribution module 106,693,809.66 (extra 26,712,763.38 unreachable); IBC escrows 11,163,090.31; liquid float 241,454,975.96 LIKE.
Only 3 bonded validators of 131: Civic Liker 212,397,484.82 (34.7%), Oldcat 203,589,620.28 (33.3%), Yasu 196,248,318.05 (32.0%) — 100% of bonded power; quorum = 244.9M LIKE of votes.
Solo-quorum stake 408,156,948.77 LIKE = $602,785 notional at v3 price $0.001477; not executable (AMM inventory 2,673,595.45 LIKE = 152.7x short; liquid float 241.45M < requirement).

Deposit path: min_deposit 100,000 LIKE, acquisition cost ~$111 (buy from Osmosis pool 553, fee-aware), refundable on pass/reject, burned only on veto; then the 3 validators decide. Historical precedent: ~25 CP spends passed (largest 20M LIKE prop 47, 15M prop 53); hostile spam proposals 79/82/83 vetoed; no proposal since prop 99 (Oct-2025), v2 governance obsoleted in favour of Snapshot.

CP realizable via dump into the 3 live Osmosis pools (555: $1,503.59; 553: $749.33; 1242: $371.33; dust ~$0.12) = $2,577.16 fee-aware (second CI run; $2,587.26 first run — price drift), vs nominal $118,119.78 at $0.001477 (corpus $135k at ~$0.001688). v2 LIKE inventory across all 3,656 Osmosis pools: 2,673,595.45 LIKE.

v3 context (not v2-gov-controlled): Base token 0x1ee5dd1794c28f559f94d2cc642bae62dc3be5cf, 1.5B supply, 2-of-3 treasury multisig 0x3aFaEA57802E0b8380d6461a62efbd5346752e83 holds 262,852,138 v3 LIKE (~$382k); CoinGecko likecoin-2 price $0.001454-0.001477, 24h vol $59.92 (Uniswap V4 Base only).

Corpus corrections: 'CP $135k' is a nominal mark (realizable ~$2.6k); '> CP' understates it — solo capture is impossible (408.16M LIKE vs 241.45M total liquid supply); the extra 26.71M LIKE in the distribution module is not proposal-spendable.
caveats: Capture-class headline (~$2.6k) is conditional on the 3 bonded validators passing a hostile CommunityPoolSpendProposal to an anonymous address; pass probability is a judgment (no precedent of a hostile spend passing; routine CP spends historically passed with automated Yes votes).

'v2 LIKE unconvertible' rests on the official LikeCoin announcement ('v2 tokens will lose all value' after 2026-02-02) and the migration app's own copy; the migration URL still resolves. If the operator honoured late migrations for a captured address, the nominal $118k would apply — but that is an off-chain courtesy, not an unprivileged on-chain path (the CP is module-held and has no key to attest with).

USD values move with LIKE v3 ($0.00145-0.00148), OSMO ($0.0340-0.0343), ATOM ($1.879); exact per-run values in ci-out/model.json. The realizable-dump figure drifted $2,577.16 -> $2,587.26 -> $2,577.16 across three runs on 2026-10-09; the headline uses the latest run. Dump model assumes single-block sale; a patient seller cannot do better (CP amount is ~30x the pools' combined inventory).

Gov params reconstructed (LCD returns HTTP 501 for /cosmos/gov/*/params); per-validator delegation breakdown not available from the public LCD (404) — irrelevant to the arithmetic since validators vote their full bonded stake.
No fork PoC is possible for Cosmos governance; verification is live LCD state + exact-version SDK v0.46.16 source analysis + a reproducible CI evidence run.
one_liner: LikeCoin's $135k-nominal community pool is realizable for only ~$2.6k (v2->v3 migration closed 2026-02-02, exit liquidity dead) and cannot be captured solo (408.16M LIKE needed vs 241.45M total liquid supply / 2.67M AMM inventory); the only live route is a ~$111 refundable deposit plus the 3 bonded validators' votes — the corpus's 'uneconomic' verdict is confirmed and stronger than stated.
